progress.$description: Outline stroke width of the progress track (BR-13). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

bg.$description: Fill of the empty part of the progress track: the pure black page (BR-03). The track is separated from the page by its outline (C-05).

border.$description: Outline color of the progress track. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fill.$description: Fill of the finished part of the progress bar: brand pink (BR-01).
